item.name: Retrieves all cases

request.name: Retrieves all cases

description.content:
Returns paginated cases for the account.
Pagination (page[offset], page[limit]) is supported in all versions.
Filters (filter[last_match_activity_on][from|to], filter[correlated])
are supported only when Accept is v1.1+ (e.g. cases.v_1.1+json).
With Accept v1.0, filter params are ignored.

query.description: Page offset. Supported in all versions.
Page limit. Supported in all versions.

Optional. Returns only cases with last_match_activity_on
greater or equal to this date (ISO 8601).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

Optional. Returns only cases with last_match_activity_on
less or equal to this date (ISO 8601).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

Optional. Filters cases by whether they are correlated
to any association (true, false, or any).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

item.name: Finds persons/entities matching search criteria given case ID

request.name: Finds persons/entities matching search criteria given case ID

description.content: Returns matches (persons/entities) for a case with optional filters and pagination.

query.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return. Optional; when omitted the server uses 0 (first page). Response meta.offset.first reflects the applied offset.
Maximum number of matches to return per page. Optional; when omitted the server uses 100. Response meta.count reflects the number of items returned.
Optional filter by association Id
Optional filter by association Id only for version 3.0 or greater
Optional filter by matches with alerts only for version 1.0
Optional filter by matches with alerts only for version 1.1 or greater
Optional filter by matches with validity only for version 1.1 or greater
Optional filter by match update from date only for version 3.0 or greater
Optional filter by match update to date only for version 3.0 or greater
Optional filter by match alert update from date only for version 3.0 or greater
Optional filter by match alert update to date only for version 3.0 or greater

Optional sort parameter only for version 3.0 or greater. Format: +field (ascending) or -field (descending). Valid fields: percentage_match, match_update_date, match_creation_date, subscription_name. In URL query strings, use %2B for ascending (e.g. sort=%2Bpercentage_match); a literal + may be interpreted as a space.
